verdict.line: You lose if you throw Q into an up Counter Strike; you win if you trade with E and let Perseverance heal you back up between exchanges.

brief.thesis: Jax's Counter Strike (E, 18/16/14/12/10s cd) dodges all incoming basic attacks, including the empowered auto from Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) — but it does nothing against Judgment (E), since a spin isn't a basic attack. That single interaction defines the lane: Garen should lean on E for safe, unblockable damage and hold Q until Jax's Counter Strike is baited or on cooldown. The measured numbers back a small Garen edge (53% over 321 games) but it's tight enough that this one habit decides most trades.

theirWindow.when: his Counter Strike (E) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can pop it the instant you commit Q, dodge the empowered auto entirely, and stun-punish you for free. Throw a plain auto or E first to make him waste it before you commit Q.

yourWindow.when: his E and Leap Strike are both down
yourWindow.what: He has no dodge and no gap closer or escape. Chain autos with Judgment (E) on cooldown and land Q's silence + bonus damage without fear of the parry.

start.why: 53.5% win rate over 198 games as the higher-pick starter — the extra sustain stacks with Perseverance so you can hold trades against his Empower pokes without recalling early.

boots.why: 55.7% win rate over 316 games and by far the most-picked boots — the attack speed lets you weave more autos into Judgment's cooldown windows and feeds Conqueror faster than he can stack Equipment Mastery health.

core.why: Its proc pairs with Q's move speed burst to stick to Jax through a Leap Strike disengage, which he'll use often once behind.
Attack speed and move speed keep you in range to punish him during the window right after he burns Counter Strike or Leap Strike.
Armor penetration cuts through the bonus health his Equipment Mastery passive stacks from his own AD items, keeping your Judgment and R execute threat relevant.

situational.when: he starts kiting with leap strike range and boots of swiftness
you're ahead and want to close the game out with raw damage instead of sustained dueling
you need the extra haste to loop your R and E cooldowns faster in extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Your fight plan is repeated E and auto trades rather than one burst, and Conqueror's stacking damage and adaptive healing directly offset the burst he gets from an empowered Leap Strike or auto.

summoners.why: Run at 97.5% pick rate for this matchup — Ignite punishes his all-in windows and burns through the extra health his passive banks from items, securing kills your raw damage alone wouldn't close.

playing.title: Bait Counter Strike before Q
playing.detail: Throw a plain auto or a Judgment cast first to force him to burn his 18/16/14/12/10s Counter Strike before you commit Q, so the silence and bonus damage actually land instead of getting dodged.

playing.title: Spin every cooldown
playing.detail: Judgment isn't a basic attack, so Counter Strike can't dodge it — cast it on cooldown (13s down to 9s at max rank) as your default poke.

playing.title: Track his Empower recharge
playing.detail: His W drops from 7s to 3s cooldown by max rank, and an empowered Leap Strike or auto hits much harder — back off when you see it come off cooldown.

playing.title: Reset for passive sustain
playing.detail: Step out of range after trades to let Perseverance's regen tick before you re-engage, exactly as the matchup data recommends.

playing.title: Respect the 700-range leap
playing.detail: Leap Strike outranges both your Q (300) and E (325), so he can initiate or reset a fight from well outside your own engage range.

playing.title: Save R for a committed target
playing.detail: Even at 140s on first rank, Demacian Justice's 400-range execute can end a fight he thinks he's winning — hold it for after he's spent Counter Strike or Leap Strike.

playing.title: Cut trades before his third hit
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown and every third consecutive attack deals bonus damage, so end extended exchanges early rather than standing in extended auto range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and all win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the read on how Counter Strike interacts with Q and Judgment is the coach's own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Jax block [Q] by activating Counter Strike (E). Attack him whenever your skills come off cooldown and activate [P] to increase your sustain to gain the upper hand.
